Title: Data Engineer MX 8
Description: Estamos buscando un Data Engineer altamente capacitado, analítico y orientado a resultados para unirse a nuestro equipo. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, desarrollar y mantener la infraestructura de datos, los procesos ETL/ELT y las canalizaciones de datos que permitan el almacenamiento, procesamiento y análisis eficiente de grandes volúmenes de información. El candidato ideal siente pasión por la ingeniería de datos, la automatización y la optimización de procesos. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con científicos de datos, analistas, desarrolladores y otros equipos para garantizar que los datos sean confiables, accesibles y escalables para la toma de decisiones. Esta posición requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos, pensamiento analítico y la capacidad de desenvolverse eficazmente en un entorno dinámico y colaborativo. Responsabilidades Principales Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos escalables y eficientes. Construir y optimizar procesos ETL/ELT para integrar datos provenientes de múltiples fuentes. Diseñar y administrar almacenes de datos (Data Warehouses), Data Lakes y modelos de datos. Garantizar la calidad, integridad y disponibilidad de los datos. Optimizar consultas, procesos y flujos de datos para mejorar el rendimiento. Colaborar con analistas, científicos de datos y otros equipos para satisfacer las necesidades de información del negocio. Implementar procesos de monitoreo, validación y recuperación de datos. Automatizar tareas relacionadas con la gestión y procesamiento de datos. Documentar arquitecturas, procesos y flujos de datos. Aplicar buenas prácticas de seguridad, gobernanza y protección de datos. Habilidades y Experiencia Requeridas Experiencia comprobada como Data Engineer, Data Platform Engineer o en un puesto similar. Dominio de SQL y experiencia con bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL. Experiencia desarrollando procesos ETL/ELT y canalizaciones de datos. Conocimiento de lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, Scala o similares. Experiencia con plataformas de procesamiento de datos como Apache Spark, Hadoop o tecnologías equivalentes. Familiaridad con plataformas en la nube como AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) o Microsoft Azure. Experiencia con herramientas de orquestación y automatización como Apache Airflow o similares. Conocimiento de herramientas de control de versiones como Git. Comprensión de arquitectura de datos, modelado de datos y optimización de rendimiento. Excelentes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipos multidisciplinarios. Calificaciones Preferidas Experiencia con servicios de datos en la nube como BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, Azure Synapse o similares. Conocimiento de herramientas de streaming de datos como Apache Kafka o equivalentes. Experiencia en empresas SaaS, startups o entornos de datos a gran escala. Conocimiento de prácticas de DataOps y automatización de procesos. Certificaciones en plataformas de nube o tecnologías de datos (deseables). Título universitario en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ingeniería de Software o un campo relacionado (preferido). Competencias Clave Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas. Atención al detalle y enfoque en la calidad de los datos. Organización y gestión del tiempo. Colaboración y comunicación efectiva. Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo. Proactividad e innovación. Responsabilidad y orientación a resultados. Al postularte a esta posición, crearemos tu Simera Professional Key (SPK) , una clave única que te ayudará a conectar con empleadores, destacar entre otros candidatos y encontrar la oportunidad laboral que mejor se adapte a tu perfil.

Este puesto definirá, construirá y comunicará la visión técnica y arquitectónica para la Collaboration Services Platform para garantizar que los sistemas y soluciones sean adecuados y cumplan con los requisitos del negocio. Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con el Platform Manager y otros miembros del equipo para asegurar la modernización continua y la integración de las plataformas de colaboración. Este puesto está integrado en el equipo de Collaboration Services , que brinda soporte a plataformas como Microsoft 365, Zoom, Box, Adobe y SharePoint. Responsabilidades clave Liderar la visión técnica y la estrategia arquitectónica, brindando soporte técnico para problemas y consultas de los usuarios finales sobre la Collaboration Services Platform (Microsoft 365, Zoom, Box, SharePoint, etc.), asegurando la escalabilidad, rendimiento y cumplimiento futuros. Gestionar migraciones de plataformas, incorporación de empresas adquiridas y racionalización de tecnologías de colaboración. Colaborar con especialistas en monitoreo y automatización empresarial para construir sistemas de alertas inteligentes que aborden proactivamente los problemas de colaboración de los usuarios finales. Fundamentos de redes y seguridad – Conocimiento básico a intermedio en gestión de redes. Pensamiento sistémico y arquitectura ágil – Capacidad para abordar sistemas de forma integral y guiar la dirección técnica en entornos Agile/SAFe. Enfoque en el cliente – Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas, diagnóstico y solución de incidencias. Perspectiva global – Comodidad para trabajar entre culturas, regiones y zonas horarias, con un compromiso constante hacia la experiencia del usuario y los objetivos de la empresa. Comunicación y colaboración – Capacidad para trabajar junto a ingenieros, arquitectos, product managers y usuarios finales para resolver problemas complejos. Educación, certificaciones y licencias Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, Tecnologías de la Información o disciplina relacionada (o experiencia equivalente). Certificaciones Preferidas Microsoft 365 Certified Zoom Certified Administrator Google Workspace Admin Experiencia requerida Mínimo 9 años en puestos de ingeniería o arquitectura en TI, enfocados en administración de plataformas, automatización e ingeniería de sistemas. Experiencia con Visual Studio, Microsoft Office 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Zoom Workplace y plataformas de Comunicaciones Unificadas. Éxito demostrado en la gestión de plataformas de colaboración empresarial y soporte a miles de usuarios globales. Experiencia implementando infrastructure as code (IaC), monitoreo automatizado de plataformas y prácticas cloud-native DevSecOps . Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno híbrido, distribuido globalmente, con partes interesadas multifuncionales. Disponibilidad para dar soporte a plataformas globales de colaboración en múltiples zonas horarias, con trabajo ocasional fuera de horario durante migraciones o actualizaciones críticas. Mentalidad proactiva para la resolución de problemas y enfoque orientado al servicio. Disposición para liderar la modernización de plataformas y apoyar iniciativas de transformación de sistemas heredados. Title: Senior React Native Engineer ID74262
Description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and implement a multi-tier sync architecture — from local device store through restaurant edge to cloud backend — for a high-volume QSR platform. You will apply conflict-resolution strategies including vector clocks and merge policies, implement event sourcing, CQRS, and saga patterns across order, kitchen, payment, and receipt flows, and model the PostgreSQL cloud data layer against local and edge stores. The role requires deep offline-first experience beyond simple caching, with a React Native and Node.js delivery stack. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design multi-tier synchronization across local device storage, restaurant edge, and cloud backend with offline-first guarantees; - Implement conflict-resolution strategies, including vector clocks, last-write-wins, merge policies, and eventual consistency; - Apply event sourcing, CQRS, and saga patterns for order, kitchen, payment, and receipt flows; - Use real-time pub/sub or WebSockets to maintain live state across devices; - Model the cloud data layer on PostgreSQL and define reconciliation between local, edge, and cloud data stores. MUST HAVES - 4+ years of software engineering experience with production distributed-data or synchronization work; - Strong React Native , TypeScript , and Node.js ; - Experience with offline-first or local-first data beyond simple caching; - Solid distributed systems fundamentals, including conflict resolution, eventual consistency, idempotency, and ordering; - Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous messaging; - Experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling; - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot; - Upper-intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES - Experience with CRDT-based synchronization, such as AutoMerge or Yjs; - Experience with a local-first synchronization engine such as ElectricSQL; - Experience with mobile local persistence technologies such as SQLite, MMKV, or WatermelonDB; - Experience with PostgreSQL JSONB or document modeling; - QSR, retail, or high-volume transactional experience. PERKS AND BENEFITS - Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. - Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. - Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. - Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
Industries: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description: At KMS Technology Mexico, we are passionate about building innovative software solutions that drive impact. As part of an international tech company, we offer a collaborative and inclusive environment where your ideas matter and your growth is our priority. Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Quality Assurance Engineer with a strong focus on manual testing across both Salesforce and non-Salesforce applications. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and consistency of systems that support core business processes. The ideal candidate will bring solid experience testing Salesforce (Sales Cloud) while also being comfortable validating integrations and workflows that extend beyond Salesforce. This role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams in dynamic environments. Responsibilities: Define and execute test cases, test strategies and test plans based on business requirements and system behavior across Salesforce and integrated applications. Perform manual testing including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing across multiple systems. Conduct exploratory testing to identify defects, edge cases, and usability issues. Validate data integrity and accuracy across Salesforce and connected systems. Document and track defects clearly, including detailed reproduction steps and impact assessment. Generate and communicate test execution reports, progress updates, and quality metrics to stakeholders and team. Collaborate closely with developers, POs, PMs, business analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure proper test coverage. Support biweekly production releases, including validation activities scheduled on Wednesdays (afternoon) and occasionally on Saturdays (midday); schedule may evolve based on business needs. Participate in test planning, requirement reviews, and solution validation discussions. Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities in testing processes and coverage. Stay current with Salesforce platform updates and ensure testing aligns with new features and changes. Coordinate with the offshore QA team on task assignments, status updates, and other collaborative efforts to support effective work handoff. Support the testing and validation of emergency releases and unplanned fixes to help ensure quality and stability in Production environments. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with strong focus on manual testing. Hands-on experience testing Salesforce Sales Cloud, including core functionalities and data validation. Experience testing integrations and applications outside of Salesforce. Strong experience creating and executing test plans and test cases. Willingness and ability to quickly learn new business processes and rules as they continue to evolve. Proven ability to write clear, detailed defect reports and track issues through resolution. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail. Excellent communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional environments. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Familiarity with ticketing systems such as Jira and test management tools like Xray or Zephyr. Experience with test automation tools is a plus. Nice to Have Experience with Experience Cloud or Revenue Cloud. Broader experience testing non-Salesforce platforms and distributed systems. Additional Information Location: Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico (Hybrid) Benefits and Perks Perks you enjoy at KMS Mexico Mexican law benefits 15 days of PTO (in year zero, from the first year onwards it is 3 days per year). 5 days' leave for the death of immediate family members, negotiable. Major Medical Expenses Insurance with coverage for immediate dependents (spouse and children). Annual performance bonus (≈10% of annualized salary). Annual salary adjustment. Employee Referral Bonus. Paid Certifications / Courses Coursera License. 5% Savings Fund. 5% Grocery Vouchers.

Title: Software Engineer Backend
Description: STAND 8 provides end-to-end IT solutions and staffing services to enterprise partners across North America, with operational presence in Mexico supporting a wide range of technology, engineering, and business roles. This role is responsible for leading the design and implementation of major features and services within the Platform Catalog ecosystem. The position drives architecture decisions, builds scalable backend services, and supports real-time data pipelines that power advertising platforms. This individual partners closely with product managers and stakeholders to turn business goals into technical outcomes while promoting reliability, performance, and observability. The role also provides technical leadership through mentoring, team coordination, and production support participation. We are headquartered in Zapopan, Jalisco, and this hybrid role is based in Andares; however, we are open to interviewing qualified candidates located anywhere in Mexico. Location & Work Type Location: Zapopan, Jalisco Work Type: Hybrid Key Responsibilities Lead the design and implementation of major features or services within the Platform Catalog ecosystem. Drive architectural discussions and propose scalable solutions aligned with engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence. Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business goals into technical outcomes. Advocate for system reliability, performance, and observability across multiple integrations. Design APIs to consume and produce data and build backend applications to power advertising platforms using Java, REST/GraphQL APIs, Docker, and Kubernetes. Use Kafka, Aerospike, and Elasticsearch to support a real-time data pipeline for the broader advertising team. Build and support highly available, large-scale distributed systems using microservices architecture. Participate in and help manage on-call and production support rotations to troubleshoot issues during off-hours and promotional events. Coordinate with team members to assign tasks, set goals, monitor progress, and resolve technical issues. Provide technical mentoring and guidance that fosters continuous learning and improvement. Qualifications : 6-8 years of software engineering experience with a track record of delivering production-grade systems. Deep expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, and API design. Proficiency in Java, with strong debugging and optimization skills. Experience operating in cloud-native environments (preferably GCP). Ability to influence design decisions and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication skills in English / Spanish / both depending on project needs. Preferred (Optional): Experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Aerospike, and Elasticsearch. Experience with microservices architecture for highly available, large-scale distributed systems. Experience participating in on-call and production support rotations. Experience with tools, technologies, or methodologies related to observability, system reliability, and platform engineering. About Us STAND 8 provides end-to-end IT solutions to enterprise partners across the United States and globally with offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, New York, Mexico, Japan, India, and more. STAND 8 focuses on the "bleeding edge" of technology and leverages automation, process, marketing, and over fifteen years of success and growth to provide a world-class experience for our customers, partners, and employees. Our mission is to impact the world positively by creating success through PEOPLE, PROCESS, and TECHNOLOGY. Check out more at www.stand8.io; and reach out today to explore opportunities to grow together!
